verdict.rationale: Helicone's webhooks docs list "Real-time evaluation" as a use case: completed live requests trigger webhooks, which can be filtered by properties, so responses can be scored as production traffic flows. The scoring logic, however, appears to run in the user's own receiving system. The pack shows no built-in evaluator library, no online-eval configuration, and no dashboard of eval scores over live traffic. Missing for 10: native, Helicone-hosted evaluators running continuously on production traffic, documented setup for evaluator definitions and score storage or visualization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Real-time evaluation: Automatically score and evaluate LLM responses for quality, safety, and relevance
Webhooks provide instant notifications when LLM requests complete, allowing you to automate workflows, score responses, and integrate AI activity with external systems.
Only requests matching ALL specified properties will trigger webhooks.
